description.fun: Maractus shakes its body in rhythm to make a sound just like maracas, and its up-tempo song and dance startles the bird Pokémon that try to eat its flower seeds into flying off. Once a year it scatters those seeds, packed with nutrients, a precious food source in the desert. Its look mixes a flowering cactus and a maraca, and its Japanese name, Maracacchi, adds a hint of mariachi.
description.guide: Maractus is a Grass-type cactus Pokémon of arid regions. It moves rhythmically to make maraca-like sounds that scare off bird Pokémon, and once a year it scatters nutritious seeds. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A dancing cactus that rattles like maracas.
